hebrewText: וְ/עָמְד֣וּ זָרִ֔ים וְ/רָע֖וּ צֹאנְ/כֶ֑ם וּ/בְנֵ֣י נֵכָ֔ר אִכָּרֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/כֹרְמֵי/כֶֽם

tokens.bdb: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
tokens.kjv: abide (behind), appoint, arise, cease, confirm, continue, dwell, be employed, endure, establish, leave, make, ordain, be (over), place, (be) present (self), raise up, remain, repair, [phrase] serve, set (forth, over, -tle, up), (make to, make to be at a, with-) stand (by, fast, firm, still, up), (be at a) stay (up), tarry.

tokens.bdb: to turn aside (especially for lodging); hence to be aforeigner, strange, profane; specifically (active participle) to commit adultery
tokens.kjv: (come from) another (man, place), fanner, go away, (e-) strange(-r, thing, woman).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to turn aside ; hence to be aforeigner
tokens.enLiteralWord: to turn aside ; hence to be aforeigner
tokens.explanation: to turn aside ; hence to be aforeigner
tokens.explanationEn: to turn aside ; hence to be aforeigner

tokens.bdb: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] break, companion, keep company with, devour, eat up, evil entreat, feed, use as a friend, make friendship with, herdman, keep (sheep) (-er), pastor, [phrase] shearing house, shepherd, wander, waste.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively
tokens.enLiteralWord: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively
tokens.explanation: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively
tokens.explanationEn: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively

tokens.bdb: a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively
tokens.explanation: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: a collective name for a flock ; also figuratively

tokens.bdb: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.

tokens.bdb: foreign, or (concretely) a foreigner, or (abstractly) heathendom

tokens.kjv: vine dresser (as one or two words).
